facility: Winchester Water Treatment Plant, Roseburg, Oregon
source: City of Roseburg, Water Treatment Facilities Preliminary Design Report, July 2009 (public record)
question: Can the Winchester Water Treatment Plant be expanded from its current 12 mgd to 18 mgd? For each unit along the flow path, determine whether it limits 18 mgd, the flow at which it becomes limiting, and the least-cost modification that makes 18 mgd work.

definitions.definition: Nominal capacity is treatment-rated flow meeting regulatory/loading criteria; hydraulic capacity is ability to pass flow through piping/pumping/volumes; firm capacity is with largest unit out of service.

collection.question: Can the Winchester WTP be expanded from its current 12 mgd to 18 mgd? For each unit along the flow path, determine whether it limits 18 mgd, the flow at which it becomes limiting, and the least-cost modification that makes 18 mgd work.

rfi.issue: Raw-water pump rated Q/TDH, pump count, and firm vs nominal unknown; 2002 firm 15.0 mgd conflicts with 2006 14 mgd with 3 pumps and Pump 3 deficiency cause unknown; VFD scope incomplete.
rfi.reason: Cannot compute station TDH at 18 mgd with higher raw-pipeline HL (Table 4-1) without pump curves, ages, and N-1 basis
rfi.resolution: ASSUMPTION with reason: For 18-mgd screening assume firm capacity is governed by demonstrated ~14-15 mgd (p.109) and station LIMITS 18 mgd until proven otherwise, because demonstrated test is more conservative than any unstated nameplate; assume 4 pumps with largest out (N-1) as firm basis per rules. Reason: protects against over-crediting untested nameplates given Pump 3 deficiency and lower 2006 result.

rfi.issue: High-service pump count, rated Q/TDH, firm capacity, and system HGL to Reservoir Hill (710 ft) not in available pages; VFD scope and transmission completion status unclear.
rfi.reason: Cannot determine flow at which HSPS/transmission binds 18 mgd without pump curves and system headloss to elev 710
rfi.resolution: ASSUMPTION with reason: Assume HSPS + transmission LIMITS 18 mgd pending data, because surge design only to 14.0 mgd (p.117) and report notes higher head may be needed >18 mgd and phased 30-in parallels may be incomplete (p.118); assume least-cost is staged pump + pipeline phasing, not site short main. Reason: avoids assuming unbuilt transmission capacity.

rfi.issue: Filter number, area, media, design loading rate (gpm/sf), N-1 firm filtration rate, backwash duration, and effluent/FTW piping ratings not in available pages; only 4-filter implication (clearwell zone 1 under four filters p.114) and 20-in influents/463-464 ft level given.
rfi.item: Filters, filter effluent and filter-to-waste piping
rfi.reason: Cannot compute loading at 12 vs 18 mgd or with one filter out/wasting without area and rating
rfi.resolution: ASSUMPTION with reason: Assume 4 filter bays (per under the four filters p.114) and assume existing filters are treatment-rated near 12 mgd total so 18 mgd REQUIRES additional filter area or higher-rate media proof, because single-basin pretreatment rated 12 mgd (p.111) implies matched filter nominal. Reason: prevents assuming higher-rate filtration without regulatory proof; field test must establish loading/breakthrough.

rfi.issue: Rapid-mix basin volume, detention, mixer G/power, and headloss at 18 mgd (both basins parallel) missing; drawing levels 467.5/466.0/454.0 single-read.
rfi.reason: Cannot verify detention/G or water-surface vs freeboard at 18 mgd
rfi.resolution: ASSUMPTION with reason: Assume rapid mix does NOT limit 18 mgd hydraulically if both basins operated parallel as intended (p.110), but treatment (G/detention) must be verified by test. Reason: parallel operation halves velocity per basin; least-cost is operate both, no new basin assumed until test fails.

rfi.issue: Floc/sed detention, SOR, weir loading at 12 vs 9 mgd per basin (18 mgd/2) missing; max influent-channel WS at 12 mgd sentence truncated; launder invert 465.83 vs trough bottom 464.63 appears inverted (invert above bottom) - conflict; drawing MAX WS 465.95 vs OF 465.00 single-read.
rfi.reason: Cannot find limiting flow for SOR/weir/freeboard without geometry and criteria
rfi.resolution: ASSUMPTION with reason: Assume second parallel basin as planned (p.110-p.111) makes 18 mgd (9 mgd/basin) TREATMENT-adequate for study, but hydraulic limit 22-24 mgd set by settled-water pipe (p.112) governs; flag launder-elev conflict as drafting/definition error to confirm in field, do not use 465.83 for head calc until confirmed. Reason: uses report-stated 18 mgd nominal / 24 mgd hydraulic intent while quarantining suspect elev.

rfi.issue: Settled-water 42-in pipeline length, C-factor, connection point for second basin, and HL at 18 mgd not given beyond 2.8-in at 13.1 mgd and 6-in below weir; ultimate 22-24 mgd stated but calculation basis missing.
rfi.reason: Cannot calibrate run_profile/profile_capacity without length/C and tie-in
rfi.resolution: ASSUMPTION with reason: Assume single 42-in calibration point (2.8-in at 13.1 mgd p.111) is representative and assume HL scales with flow per Table-type hydraulics to be verified, with limit 22-24 mgd per p.112 accepted as report-given. Reason: only field-measured HL available; must re-measure at higher flow before design.

rfi.issue: Intake approach-velocity flow limit redacted ([withheld] To achieve greater intake capacity p.109); river levels vs opening submergence at low water (dwg 432/420/415.5/408.0 single-read) and trash-rack/screen headloss missing.
rfi.reason: Cannot compute Q at 0.4 fps without submerged opening area at design low water
rfi.resolution: ASSUMPTION with reason: Assume intake fish-velocity LIMITS below 18 mgd until field proves submergence/area, because 0.4 fps on 4x 4-ft openings is highly restrictive at low river stage and screens only pass up to 18 mgd or more (p.109, marginal wording). Reason: fish criterion is regulatory and wording or more indicates no margin; least-cost likely opening/screen expansion per Sec 6 options.

rfi.issue: Raw and finished pipeline headloss basis (length, Hazen-Williams C, fittings, meter loss) not given for Table 4-1/4-3; cannot independently verify 0.25 ft/100ft at 18 mgd or station TDH increase.
rfi.reason: Need length/C to model pumped legs in run_hydraulics and gravity legs in run_profile
rfi.resolution: ASSUMPTION with reason: For screening accept Table 4-1/4-3 velocities/HL as report-given design values (p.110/p.117) without recomputing, to be calibrated by field differential-pressure test. Reason: avoids silent invention of C/length; uses document units/values directly.

rfi.issue: Clearwell CT/baffling factor, required detention at 18 mgd, inlet/outlet hydraulics, and operating depth vs 10.5 ft max missing; 75 min at current max implies ~50 min at 18 mgd but disinfectant credit unknown.
rfi.reason: Cannot determine if 627k gal with unbaffled/baffled zones meets regulation at 18 mgd
rfi.resolution: ASSUMPTION with reason: Assume clearwell VOLUME is adequate for flow (75 min at ~12 mgd => ~50 min at 18 mgd) but CT LIMITS unless baffling/chlorine proves otherwise, because two zones are unbaffled (p.114). Reason: volume alone does not equal CT; conservative for health-based criterion.
